definition-changed.answer: The rule's input/output procedure is the procedure-name-1 [THRU procedure-name-2] range of SORT/MERGE in both editions; §2002:4 (entry 4.150) ('one or more successive paragraphs or sections') names the same range that §2023:3.145 does. Scope unchanged.

pending-clause.answer: Read §2002:14.5.12.1.1 through §2002:14.5.12.2 against §2023:14.6.13.1.1 through §2023:14.6.13.2. The 2002 differences are: no MERGE/SORT, fatal-EC-I-O or PERFORM WHEN steps in fatal processing (§2023:14.6.13.1.3 (items 2-4) are 2023-only), the 2002 non-fatal wording, and the incompatible-data text. EC-FLOW-RELEASE is Fatal in the 2002 table. The RELEASE executed outside a SORT is not itself a MERGE or SORT statement, so 2023's item 2 does not reach it, and 2002 item 2 (declarative; RESUME continues) governs as in 2023. The witness pb349_sort_merge_flow_ec (accept [2002]) raises it from the main line with no SORT active and MATCHes at 2002.
